findings.whatClosed: The reviewed tamper (null the marker row, erased:true) is now INTEGRITY_FAILURE (document); moving the erased flag from one slot to another fails (document); re-pointing an entry with an integer `of` fails (chain); un-erasing fails; the hold-row variant fails (p8 G1 dropHoldRow).
findings.residual: The seal and the verifier read the erased flag differently. The envelope counts a slot as erased only when `erased === true` (`chain.filter(c=>c?.erased===true)`), but verify() accepts a null row for any truthy `erased` (`c.erased ? doc.rows[i]!==null : ...`, custody.mjs line 74). A keyless actor who nulls the marker row and sets `erased` to 1, "true", {} or [] leaves the sealed erased set unchanged, so the document verifies, and the erasure hold is gone.
findings.reproduction: r1-tamper.mjs: hold, then eraseHealthFacts(hold) (the marker is the only hold, the reference is cleared). In raw storage set rows[m]=null and chain[m].erased=1 (or "true", {}, []), with no key. read OK, markers 0, view VALID_PLAN, 4 executable sessions. erased:true on the same slot gives INTEGRITY_FAILURE:document. The fix's own test (v1fc-review-fixes.test.mjs:99-102) tries only erased:true.
findings.smallestFix: One predicate in verify(): treat a slot as erased only when `c.erased === true`, and fail 'chain' (or 'shape') for an entry that has an `erased` key with any other value. A closed key set per chain entry (seq, recordedAt, digest, of, mac, erased) would also close it. Add the four values to the tamper test.
findings.cycleNote: The single fix cycle is used. Under the Founder's rule this closes as a named blocker unless whoever owns the cycle rule allows the one-line fix. That is not a decision for this role.

findings.probe: r2-legacy.mjs and p1c-legacy.mjs. V1.generateProgram(R5-INPUT-1) returns INVALID_INPUT and V1.evaluateProgram on a legacy program returns HOLD. Onboarding with the R5 intake returns INVALID_INPUT and stores nothing: read is NOT_ENROLLED (not INTEGRITY_FAILURE), and the same athlete id then enrolls with a V1 intake (PROPOSED). Restarting with the R5 intake returns INVALID_INPUT and the record still reads. Intake versions undefined, null, 'R6-INTAKE-2' and 'r6-intake-1' are all refused. Custody enroll and restart also check validProgram before committing.

p7-target.mjs and p6-scope T. A target that differs from the session the request reports as not done returns INVALID_REQUEST with no state change, and so do an object and a 100 KB string. A quality session two weeks ahead, or a long run later this week, gets ASK (never moved or copied), the program is unchanged, and no offer is made. The other athlete's version is unchanged. r3-target-kinds.mjs: on the six other kinds that read targetSessionId, a future or current target with no evidence changes no week and makes no offer.
findings.notReopened: A past-week target whose session is already reported executed still ends in ENGINE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION with no state change. This is the class of QRE-V1FC-03 (a repeated report of a recorded session), which FIX_CYCLE_V1FC.md lists as a condition of INTEGRATION_READY. Recorded there, not reopened here.

findings.probe: p4b.mjs on 06bbc7f: after erasure, program.decisions still holds readinessRecord.cause CLINICAL, the erased hold's kind and time, and the held sports, unchanged. As recorded in FIX_CYCLE_V1FC.md.
p5-logged.mjs (a): erasing an ASK 'not 100%' report clears reference.pending. The view goes back to VALID_PLAN with no question, and only the scrubbed entry's event id remains.
p5-logged.mjs (b) and (c): on both erasure paths, a weekly review's event named beside the health event keeps its full decision entry, and erased counts only the health event.

p2-adopt.mjs A8 (stub engine, valid program hash): after LEARNING is revoked, accept of the learned rearrangement returns NOT_PENDING, because revoking LEARNING closed the waiting change (CONSENT_REVOKED). The code also refuses a LEARNED_REARRANGEMENT in accept without LEARNING.

Inventory rows present for response.unavailable (HEALTH_DERIVED, egress NONE), offer/pending and agency. Every custody error code (18 distinct) is free of canary words, and the refusal over a hold is now CHANGE_NOT_ADOPTABLE. The probe p6-scope L2 still prints FAIL only because it feeds telemetryOf the old literal code by hand; that code no longer exists in custody. L1: telemetry is clean over the new paths.

regressionCheck.result: No regression introduced by the fixes on what the review verified.
evidence: CF-OBS-1 engine layer: 7 kinds with the hold on record and no reference are CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with no proposal (p8 G6). Custody layer: the 24-kind x 4-payload sweep under a hold stays BLOCKED with nothing executable (p6 S2). Readiness requires HEALTH_SIGNALS (S3).
V1 gate: 24 kinds x wellbeing payloads open no reduction (p6 S1).

Seal and chain: tampering with agency, pending, decisions, requests, consents, schema or reference, truncation, reorder and the hold row all give INTEGRITY_FAILURE on read and write. A foreign key fails. The decline memory is sealed (p8 G1, G2; p10 G7). The p8 'dropAgency' line is a no-op on a document with no agency, as in the review.
Idempotency, stale version, server-owned and unknown fields (no echo), cross-athlete, unauthenticated (p8 G3); HEALTH_SIGNALS gate (G4); pseudonymous tombstone refusing re-enroll and writes (G5).
Restart gates unchanged: coaching consent, learningConsent, server-owned fields, clinical break, hold, injury flag, SYNTHETIC_ONLY (p3).
Telemetry and push neutral over the new paths (p6 L1).
Event extension: client values still cannot enable an event (p11). The records file now exists. That it enables nothing under the default authority here is for SSCTR/QRE, not this role.

section7Pending: The review's additions are carried into the closure record as PENDING (per the dispatch): pinning the authority files, including the event records file; request size limits; erasure reaching the program (SEC-V1FC-04) and backups; the learning model after a LEARNING revocation; per-purpose keys. Section 7's guarantee 'a removed row is an INTEGRITY_FAILURE' still does not hold while SEC-V1FC-01 is open.
